method: Independent matcher; VE's implementation NOT reused. Every one of the 187 real v4.4 confirmations matched against vNext's full 12,813-structure history by time-window overlap AND zone overlap, with forward merge/continuation chain following.
sensitivity_finding: The rate spans 0.00% - 18.18% across defensible matcher settings. VE's figure is reproduced EXACTLY at time_tolerance=100 bars with any zone overlap (4/187 = 2.14%), i.e. it is one point in a monotone family, not an identified quantity. The sensitivity was not disclosed in VE's report.
defensible_core: 2.14% - 6.42% (the IoU>0 family). The 18.18% endpoint requires IoU>0.3, which penalises legitimate re-forming (a merged candidate restarts with only 2 swings so its zone is narrower than its predecessor's) and is judged over-strict.

placebo_control.purpose: test whether the matcher discriminates or merely reads a base rate (vNext emits 21.9x more confirmations than v4.4)
placebo_control.conclusion: MY OWN base-rate-contamination hypothesis is REFUTED by this test. The matcher genuinely measures correspondence. VE's matching APPROACH is sound; only the undisclosed tolerance sensitivity is at issue.

mechanism_attribution.note: merge 0/187 and capacity 0/187 INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRM VE exactly. Abandonment is the dominant contributor, as VE disclosed.

comparison_to_v4_5.verdict: vNext is materially safer than v4.5 at EVERY setting in the defensible core, not merely at VE's chosen one. VE's section-21 conclusion HOLDS under independent, stricter measurement.
